resources.string: Native Android port of the zelda3 PC reimplementation.
Select your own copy of the game: the US release ROM (.sfc or .smc, zipped or not). The game data is built on this device and the ROM is not kept.
This is not the expected ROM (CRC32 %1$s). Use the US release, CRC32 777AAC2F.
File not recognized. Pick a .sfc, .smc, .zip or zelda3_assets.dat file.
Widescreen modes show more of the world instead of stretching the picture.
Set automatically to the widest mode that fits this screen while “Fill the screen” is on.
The picture keeps its proportions, with bars where it does not reach the edges.
Covers the whole screen, hiding about %1$d lines of the game at the top and at the bottom.
Covers the whole screen, hiding about %1$d columns of the game at each side.
This mode matches the screen exactly.
Controllers are detected automatically. The on-screen controls hide while one is in use and come back when you touch the screen.
Mirror warps to the Dark World
Optional changes from the zelda3 project. All are off by default, which plays exactly like the original game.
L and R cycle through items. Y + direction reorders items in the inventory; hold X, L or R on the item screen to assign an item to that button. If X gets an item, Select opens the map.
Change direction while running with the Pegasus Boots.
The Magic Mirror also takes you from the Light World to the Dark World.
Hearts, rupees and other drops can be picked up by hitting them with the sword.
With the level 2 sword or better, pots break with a slash.
Silences the alarm that plays while health is low.
Pressing a button skips the opening sequence.
Rupee, bomb and arrow counts turn yellow when full.
Up to four bombs on screen at once instead of two.
The wallet holds up to 9999 rupees instead of 999.

Fixes about 40 bugs of the original, such as walking on water, crossing pits by dashing, magic going below zero or being refunded by the Cane of Somaria, and the exploration glitch. Leave it off if you rely on these glitches, for example in speedruns.
Currently a single fix: the Zoras in Misery Mire placed in shallow water can now appear, as intended. It makes that area slightly harder.
Press X on the bird travel map to cancel the trip.
Softens flashing effects, like the Virtual Console releases.
Draws every sprite on each line, so crowded scenes no longer flicker.
Double-tap the screen to open the menu
The back button and, on a controller, Select+Start or the right stick button also open the menu.
Reset the game? Progress since your last save will be lost.
Your progress is saved automatically when you quit.
Jump to the start of a chapter with the reference saves from upstream.
Load this chapter? Progress since your last save will be lost.

These are the game’s own three files. They use the cartridge format, so an .srm from an emulator (Snes9x, RetroArch, …) works both ways. Importing one replaces all three files and clears the resume point.
Replace the three game files with this .srm? The current ones are kept as sram.bak, and the resume point is cleared so the game starts at the file select screen.
No save states yet. Create them from the in-game menu.
A backup is a .zip with the game files and every save state, ready to keep or move to another device.
Restore this backup? It replaces the game files and all save states on this device.
Cheats take effect right away. Whatever they change (rupees, items) is kept in your save file the next time the game saves.
Health refills to full every frame. A single hit bigger than your health can still defeat you.
Bombs stay at your bag\'s capacity.
Arrows stay at your quiver\'s capacity.
Rupees count up to the maximum (999, or 9999 with the bigger wallet enhancement).
Inside dungeons you always have at least one small key.
Link ignores walls and obstacles. Turn it off before leaving an area, or you may fall out of the map.
RAM codes for the US version, such as 7EF36D:A0, written every frame. Codes that patch the ROM (Game Genie, or addresses outside 7E/7F) do not apply to this port.
Use 6 hex digits of address in 7E0000–7FFFFF and 2 of value, e.g. 7EF36D:A0.
This app contains no game data. You must supply a ROM from a cartridge you own. Based on snesrev/zelda3 (MIT).
